mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workers (id, host, concurrency, active_tasks, last_heartbeat, started_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{host}, #{concurrency}, #{activeTasks}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE host = VALUES(host), concurrency = VALUES(concurrency), active_tasks = VALUES(active_tasks), last_heartbeat = VALUES(last_heartbeat)
mapper.select: SELECT id, host, concurrency, active_tasks, DATE_FORMAT(last_heartbeat, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS last_heartbeat, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, last_heartbeat, #{now}) * 1000 AS heartbeat_age_ms, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, last_heartbeat, #{now}) * 1000 > #{staleAfterMs} THEN 'STALE' ELSE 'ONLINE' END AS state FROM workers ORDER BY id
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(concurrency), 0) FROM workers WHERE last_heartbeat > #{threshold}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workers WHERE last_heartbeat > #{threshold}
